title: Topic 9
japanese_text: 中学校時代、人と話すのが苦手だった私は、人前で<u>おどおどして</u>しまい、それが原因で、ある人物から<u>陰気な</u>奴だとからかわれ、<u>嫌がらせ</u>を受けていた。20年後、私の会社に面接に来たのはその人物だった。世の中とは<u>皮肉な</u>ものだ。
english_translation: In junior high school, I wasn't very good at talking to people, so I always got nervous in front of others. Because of that, I was teased and harassed for being a depressing kind of guy. Twenty years later, the person who had teased me came to my company to interview for a job. The world is an ironic place.
